description: Dati par gājēju un velosipēdistu kustību is a dataset listed in data.gov.lv, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Valmieras pilsētas pašvaldība. The dataset contains data on the movement of pedestrians and cyclists over one of the pedestrian bridges in Valmiera. Within each day, the number of both categories is available, depending on the direction - to the city center or from the side of the city center. Coverage: Valmieras pilsētas pašvaldība. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian and cyclist movement data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Valmieras pilsētas pašvaldība. Its keywords include Gājēji, velosipēdisti, sensors, laikapstākļi. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLS, 7Z. The listing shows 2019-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lv.
